name: Massachusetts
sources: 5.0% rate on wages, interest, dividends and long-term gains; 4% surtax on income over $1,107,750 for 2026: Mass. DOR, 'Massachusetts Tax Rates' (mass.gov/info-details/massachusetts-tax-rates)

Personal exemptions ($4,400 single/MFS, $6,800 HoH, $8,800 MFJ), $1,000 per dependent: 2025 Form 1, lines 2a-2b (mass.gov/doc/2025-form-1-massachusetts-resident-income-tax-return/download); Mass. DOR 'Personal Income Tax Exemptions'
Age 65+ exemption $700 per person: Mass. DOR '2025 TaxTips for Seniors and Retirees' (mass.gov/doc/dor-tax-tips-for-seniors-and-retirees/download)
Charitable contribution deduction restored from tax year 2023 (G.L. c. 62 §3(B)(a)(13)), claimed on Schedule Y without federal itemizing; TIR 24-14
provisional: Age 65+ exemption: DOR's 2025 TaxTips and exemptions page give $700, but the 2024-2025 Form 1 line 2c reads '$1,700' as extracted; $700 used
notes: The refundable Child and Family Tax Credit ($440 per child under 13 or dependent 65+) and the senior circuit breaker credit are not included.
Massachusetts' deduction for Social Security and Medicare paid on wages (up to $2,000 per worker) is not included.
